_comment: Command->filter registry for the RTK-style output compressor (v3.5 'The Diet'). Read at runtime by get-shit-done/bin/lib/compress-filters/index.cjs and the gsd-compress.cjs wrapper. Each entry: { name (STABLE id), heads: [argv-head strings], filter: <module basename in compress-filters/>, enabled }. Phase 72 ships the FRAMEWORK with an empty entries list (default behavior = _passthrough identity). The six starter filters register here in Phase 73. registry_version bumps on any entry change. NEVER map a non-idempotent/destructive command here: the Phase 74 PreToolUse rewrite path re-runs mapped commands, so only read-only/idempotent reporting commands are eligible. Test seam: GSD_COMPRESS_REGISTRY_PATH.
